MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: You may refer to the original job posting to review the qualifications required for this position.

Details.JobSummary: This is an exclusive posting job opportunity announcement, created specifically for a selectee required to complete the Administrative Careers With America (ACWA) assessment in accordance with the Luevano Consent Decree. If you have been provided this link it is because you have been tentatively selectee for a position with the Department of Army, however due to the appointment eligibility with which you applied you are required to complete and pass the ACWA exam prior to your appointment.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Civilian employees serve a vital role in supporting the Army mission. They provide the skills that are not readily available in the military, but crucial to support military operations. The Army integrates the talents and skills of its military and civilian members to form a Total Army.
